title: code_index.rebuild request
description: Bring the code index up to date with the workspace. An index already anchored at `root` is reconciled file by file against disk; a cold slot or a different root is built from scratch. `force` demands the full walk-read-parse pass even when an index is already live, which is the escape hatch for a change that left both mtime and size untouched.

root.description: Project root to index. Defaults to the current workspace root.

force.description: Rebuild wholesale instead of reconciling. Needed only when a file changed without its mtime or size changing.
